# Netflix4U

> Netflix4U is a high-speed entertainment discovery and streaming web application delivering verified catalog information for global movies, web series, anime, K-dramas, Bollywood, Hollywood, South Indian cinema, and Hindi-dubbed releases.

## Overview
Netflix4U provides clean, crawlable catalog listings, verified TMDB and IMDb metadata, multi-language audio availability details, high-definition trailer previews, and direct playback links.

## Canonical Platform Information
- **Website**: https://netflix4u.in/
- **Brand**: Netflix4U
- **Primary Content Categories**:
  - Movies: Global feature films across all release years and genres.
  - Web Series: Multi-season episodic television and streaming series.
  - Anime: Japanese animation with original and multi-audio dubbed tracks.
  - K-Drama: Korean television dramas with subtitle and dubbing options.
  - Bollywood: Hindi cinema, musical blockbusters, and indie features.
  - Hollywood: International box-office titles and franchises.
  - South Indian: Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada cinema.
  - Hindi Dubbed: Dual-audio and regional dubbed releases.
  - Trending: Real-time popular entertainment based on viewer activity.

## Key Public Routes
- Homepage: https://netflix4u.in/
- Movies: https://netflix4u.in/movies
- Web Series: https://netflix4u.in/series
- Anime: https://netflix4u.in/anime
- K-Drama: https://netflix4u.in/kdrama
- Bollywood: https://netflix4u.in/bollywood
- Hollywood: https://netflix4u.in/hollywood
- South Indian: https://netflix4u.in/south-indian
- Hindi Dubbed: https://netflix4u.in/hindi-dubbed
- Trending: https://netflix4u.in/trending

## Technical Architecture & Compliance
- **Rendering**: Static progressive web application (PWA) with fast client hydration and service worker caching.
- **Metadata**: Verified against TMDB and IMDb canonical records.
- **Accessibility**: Full WCAG 2.1 AA compliant navigation, high contrast UI, and assistive technology support.
- **Machine Discovery**: Clean semantic HTML, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (WebSite, Organization, Movie, TVSeries), and XML sitemaps.
